name: SAPO VR
summary:
Sapo VR brings the traditional Latin American coin-toss game to virtual reality. Aim and throw coins into the frog’s mouth or other scoring holes on the board, just like the original Sapo/Rana game.

This VR experience recreates the different local variations of the game from multiple countries (Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Chile, Bolivia, Argentina, Spain) using immersive VR controls and realistic physics.

This is a casual skill-based game which is easy to pick up, but challenging to master. Perfect for short
